# VantaDB

> VantaDB is an embedded persistent memory and hybrid retrieval engine for AI
> agents. Rust core; Python, TypeScript/Node and WASM bindings; an HTTP API and
> an MCP server. Published to crates.io, PyPI and npm.

Every link below points to the raw Markdown source, not a rendered page. Read the
page you need; do not read this file end to end. This index covers the
263 documentation pages; it deliberately omits the 0 task files,
which are work items rather than documentation. The full inventory of every file
is in docs/index.md in the repository.

## Start here

- [VantaDB Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/README.md): Welcome to the VantaDB documentation vault
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/index.md): Section index.
- [VantaDB Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/index.md): Canonical index of the VantaDB documentation corpus.
- [specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/specs/index.md): Section index.
- [End-user documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/index.md): Section index.
- [VantaDB Wiki](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/index.md): Wiki documental de VantaDB: navegación por audiencia y mapa de cobertura del motor, bindings, servidor, MCP y ecosistema, basada en el código presente.

- [ADR-0057: Encryption at rest — envelope-cipher wiring of the core on-disk artifacts (WAL, HNSW, VantaFile, backend-KV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0057-encryption-at-rest.md): Wires the existing `encryption` feature to the real write paths with per-artifact AEAD envelopes, a wrapped-DEK key hierarchy with rotation, a provably-unique nonce scheme, and a declared no-in-place-migration policy; corrects the false SECURITY.md claim (FIND-407) by making it true, opt-in and bounded.
- [ADR-0058: Native sparse vectors — verified representation, metric, and coexistence with BM25](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0058-sparse-vectors-native-verified.md): Sparse vectors are native in VantaDB — SparseVector(BTreeMap<u32, f32>) at src/node/vector_data.rs:30, scored with DistanceMetric::SparseDot, fused with BM25 and dense via RRF; restates ADR-0011 with the code references verified against the 0.9.0 tree
- [ADR-0059: Storage-path env var unification — `VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH` is the only name](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0059-storage-path-env-unification.md): The VANTA_DB / VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH coexistence decided in ADR-0012 is gone: the CLI --db flag and Config::from_env() both read VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH, and VANTA_DB is read nowhere in the tree (FIND-89 consolidation, verified 2026-10-20)

- [Módulo: core (`vantadb` SDK + transversales)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/core.md): SDK embebido, tipos fundamentales y módulos transversales del crate vantadb: responsabilidad, entradas públicas y fuentes.
- [Módulo: ecosystem (server, bindings, providers, integrations)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/ecosystem.md): Todo lo que rodea al motor: módulo server del core, crates de servicio, hoja FFI compartida, bindings y adaptadores externos.
- [Módulo: evals (evaluación, benches, fuzz, tests)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/evals.md): Harnesses de evaluación de memoria, benchmarks, fuzzing y suites de test registradas: qué existe y qué no se afirma de ellos.
- [Módulo: graph (`graph`, `graphrag`, `gds`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/graph.md): Grafo de propiedades, traversals, GraphRAG y algoritmos GDS: superficie pública y fuentes.
- [Módulo: indexes (`index`, `vector`, `text_index`, `tokenizer`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/indexes.md): Índices vectoriales (HNSW/IVF/ScaNN/DiskANN/flat), índice de texto BM25 y métricas de distancia: estructura, entradas y fuentes.
- [Módulo: memory-budget (`governor`, `eviction`, `gc`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/memory-budget.md): Presupuesto de memoria: governor, backpressure por RSS, políticas de evicción ponderada/decaimiento bayesiano y GC — estructura y fuentes.
- [Módulo: proxy (`vanta-proxy`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/proxy.md): Proxy transparente de protocolos LLM con captura de memoria, guardrails y gobernanza: estado frozen, estructura y fuentes.
- [Módulo: query (`parser`, `planner`, `physical_plan`, `executor`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/query.md): Pipeline IQL: lexer/grammar, planner, operadores físicos y ejecutor — estructura, versión del lenguaje y fuentes.
- [Módulo: retrieval (`sdk::search`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/retrieval.md): Pipeline de recuperación híbrida: vector, lexical, fusión RRF, MMR, multi-namespace, explain y snippets — estructura y fuentes.
- [Módulo: storage (`storage`, `wal`, backends)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/modules/storage.md): Motor de almacenamiento, WAL, backends KV (Fjall/RocksDB/memoria), VantaFile y versionado on-disk: estructura y fuentes.

- [Persistencia y backups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/user/persistence.md): Modos de persistencia, backups lógicos vs físicos y recuperación: qué garantiza el motor y dónde están los límites.
- [Privacy & local LLMs — what VantaDB guarantees (and what it doesn't)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/PRIVACY.md): The exact privacy guarantees of the local-first stack — redaction-on-write, encrypted originals, certified delete, injection governance — with commands and a covered / not covered table
- [Quickstart de VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/user/quickstart.md): Primer arranque con VantaDB: qué instalar según el runtime y dónde seguir, sin duplicar el quickstart canónico.

## API reference

- [API HTTP (`vantadb-server`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/http.md): Servidor HTTP con axum: endpoints verificados, auth/RBAC por namespace, maintenance, snapshots, skills y modo MCP.
- [API MCP (`vantadb-mcp`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/mcp.md): Servidor Model Context Protocol stdio JSON-RPC 2.0: lanzamiento, herramientas, handlers y límite single-writer.
- [API de Node.js nativo (`vantadb-node`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/node.md): Binding napi-rs para Node.js: estado de publicación, superficie frente al wrapper TS y diferencias verificadas.
- [API de Python (`vantadb-py`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/python.md): Binding PyO3 publicado en PyPI: Client, sub-clientes por dominio, AsyncClient, superficie verificada y diferencias frente a otros transportes.
- [API de Rust (crate `vantadb`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/rust.md): Entrada embebida al motor: Embedded, Config, tipos centrales y re-exportaciones, con el snapshot canónico de superficie pública.
- [API de TypeScript (npm `vantadb`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/typescript.md): Wrapper TypeScript en npm: sub-clientes por dominio, clase Client sobre WASM por defecto y ruta nativa opcional vía vantadb-node.
- [API de WASM (`vantadb-wasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/wasm.md): Binding wasm-bindgen: persistencia OPFS/IDB por runtime, contadores de saneamiento observables y límites del target wasm32.
- [Bindings Namespace Map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/BINDINGS_NAMESPACES.md): Rules for the migration window
- [Certified delete - purge certificates (VER-02)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/CERTIFIED_DELETE.md): Per-surface purge certificate emitted by delete (CLI/MCP/Rust): residue inventory for store, JSON-shredded metadata, indexes and WAL tombstone; integrity hash, VER-01 chain reference and documented limits (logical vs physical purge, backups, exports)
- [Compatibility Matrix & 1.0 Readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/COMPATIBILITY.md): What each public API surface promises, how that promise is enforced
- [Deprecations Registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/DEPRECATIONS.md): Concrete deprecations of the public API surfaces and their removal windows
- [Embedded SDK Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDED_SDK.md): Source: src/sdk/mod.rs, src/sdk/builder.rs, src/sdk/api/.rs, src/sdk/graph.rs, src/sdk/search/mod.rs
- [Embeddings — BYO-Vector + embed-local](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDINGS.md): VantaDB is BYO-vector by default (“does not embed text for you”) and offers an opt-in local embedding path via the embed-local Cargo feature. No breaking changes — EmbeddingProvider is additive
- [GraphRAG API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/GRAPH_RAG.md): GraphRAG (seed → expand → retrieve → context) is exposed by the Rust SDK and all four bindings — Python, WASM, TypeScript and Node — with one canonical wire shape
- [Memory interchange format (JSONL v2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MEMORY_INTERCHANGE_FORMAT.md): The JSONL v2 contract shared by VantaDB export, import and the third-party importers (Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Letta): mapping tables, integrity manifest, frontier-format mapping, declared limits
- [Memory scopes: multi-level isolation model for hosts (MEMG-25 spec)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/memory-scopes.md): Spec-first scope model for memory hosts: scope levels, visibility, trust, authority, provenance, validity, retention, owner and writer; fields, defaults and wire; no enforcement
- [Node.js Native SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/NODE_SDK.md): vantadb-node is the native Node.js binding for VantaDB, built with
- [Paridad entre transportes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/parity.md): Qué se promete igual entre Rust, Python, WASM, TS, Node, HTTP y MCP: matrices verificadas, runner de conformidad y divergencias declaradas.
- [Public Surface Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SURFACE_MANIFEST.md): Generated inventory of every public surface with status and version
- [Python SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PYTHON_SDK.md): Python SDK reference — Client, memory records, cognitive layer (memory_capture/memory_recall), async client and typed errors
- [Scoring Semantics — VantaDB Official Score Contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/scores.md): VantaDB hybrid search combines two independent rankers
- [Search Capability Parity — VantaDB vs Milvus vs Qdrant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SEARCH_PARITY.md): 1. topk semantics under groupby — VantaDB caps total hits; Milvus/Qdrant cap the number of groups. Choose topk = groups × groupsize to emulate the vendor behavior
- [Semantic events and provenance log (MEMG-26 spec)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/memory-events.md): Spec-first semantic event model for causal memory history: event types, envelope fields, causal links and wire rules; a layer over VantaDB, not a WAL replacement
- [Shared memory: scopes, grants, and revocation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SHARING.md): Multi-agent sharing over the existing permission checker: scope mapping, grants, revocation semantics, checked reads and writes, and declared boundaries
- [Storage formats — on-disk versions and the encrypted variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/STORAGE_FORMATS.md): The on-disk format contract of VantaDB: the format versions of the WAL, the VantaFile segments, the HNSW index image and the encryption registry, the encrypted variants behind the `encryption` feature, and the constants that name them.
- [TypeScript SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/TS_SDK.md): Create a new in-memory instance. Accepts an optional Config object. To use persistent storage, call connect() or open() instead
- [Vanta Memory Engine — API Reference (`vanta-memory`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VANTA_MEMORY.md): LLM-driven crate for agent memory: L0 capture, L1 extraction/dedup, L2 scenes, L3 persona, scoped recall, context engine (compression), offload, and wiki generation.
- [VantaDB Error Handling Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/ERROR_HANDLING.md): This is the canonical contract for how VantaDB surfaces errors across every
- [VantaDB HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/HTTP_API.md): Default: http://127.0.0.1:8080
- [VantaDB IQL Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/IQL.md): The parser implements IQL version 4 (adds the AS OF valid-time clause, LIMIT/OFFSET pagination, and COUNT/SUM/GROUP BY aggregation). The version is exposed as IQL_VERSION
- [VantaDB Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MCP.md): MCP server reference — tools, profiles, and the current implementation version (tracked below)
- [Versioning & Stability Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VERSIONING.md): VantaDB follows Semantic Versioning with the standard
- [WAL Integrity — tamper-evident hash-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WAL_INTEGRITY.md): Hash-chain per WAL record (VER-01): detects altered, removed or reordered frames with exact position; documented limits (suffix truncation, consistent rewrite, archived segments) and on-demand detection via vanta-cli verify
- [WASM API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_API.md): This page is the canonical entry point for VantaDB's WebAssembly surface — the
- [WASM Persistence Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_PERSISTENCE.md): How VantaDB persists data in the browser: what exists, what the verified
- [WASM Standalone Console (Vanta Studio — mode `wasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_STANDALONE.md): The Vanta Studio console can run 100% in the browser with no server: the
- [Write receipts (VER-10) — attestation of writes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WRITE_RECEIPTS.md): Verifiable write receipts emitted by put_certified (Rust SDK): content binding (sha256), VER-01 chain reference, canonical surfaces and declared limits; point-in-time verification via schema, integrity hash and live re-scan
- [vanta-proxy Reference (Endpoints, Opt-in Features, Config)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PROXY.md): vanta-proxy is a transparent LLM wire proxy: by default it forwards bytes

This is intentional (BYO-vector): you control the embedding model, dimension, and lifecycle. Bring your own vector=[...] on put() and queryvector on search()
